definition: a representation of a person, esp. of the face, drawn, painted, photographed or sculptured; a portrait; a photograph.
example_en: He got a new portrait photograph taken for the wedding.

definition: again; once more.
example_en: He tried again and won.

definition: Śiva.
example_en: People come daily to Nandivardhana's (Śiva's) temple.

definition: an elephant in rut.
example_en: The elephant in rut shook its strong tusks.

definition: a failing to accomplish (something); such a failure.
example_en: The plan suffered a failure due to the rain.

definition: an important news.
example_en: An important news has been published in the newspaper today.

definition: a tool or apparatus for boring holes in wood, metal, stone, teeth, etc.; a drill.
example: ಹಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ರಂಧ್ರ ಕೊರೆಯಲು ದಂತವೈದ್ಯ ಬೈರಗಿ ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: The dentist used a drill to bore a hole in the tooth.

definition: to bring or reduce to ruin; to destroy; to spoil; to damage irreparably.
example_en: The flood ruined the entire town.

definition: a particular disposition or bent of mind; bias; tendency; inclination.
example: ಅವನ ಖ್ಯಾಲು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಸಂಗೀತದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

definition: to turn around, spin or rotate rapidly; to whirl.
example_en: The children played in the field, spinning around.

definition: a phrase, construction or expression, that may sometimes be grammatically peculiar by itself, that is recognised as a unit in the usage of a given language and has a meaning that differs from the literal meaning of its parts taken together; an idiom.
example: ಈ ಪಡೆಮಾತಿನ ಅರ್ಥ ಪದಗಳ ಅರ್ಥಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಬೇರೆಯೇ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The meaning of this idiom is different from the meaning of its words.

definition: a man lacking normal intelligence or understanding; a slow-witted, stupid fellow.
example_en: That stupid fellow does not know how to do accounts.

definition: a ruling over people using brutal power.
example: ಆ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರನ ದಡಪಶಾಹಿಯಿಂದ ಜನರು ಬಹಳ ನೊಂದಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The people suffered greatly from that ruler's tyranny.

definition: a narrow path that is difficult to walk or traverse on.
example: ಗುಡ್ಡದ ಮೂಲಕ ಗಸಣಿದಾರಿ ಸಾಗಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ತಲುಪಿದೆವು.
example_en: We went through the narrow, difficult path over the hill and reached the village.

definition: a stamp, seal having the signature, personalised mark or symbol, to affix on a letter or document.
example_en: An important document must have the signature seal on it.

definition: a post, on the roadside, esp. at cross roads, carrying a board giving direction for different destinations; a hand-post.
example: ಊರ ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸುವ ಕೈಗಂಬ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A hand-post showing the way was standing at the edge of the village.

definition: the act of listening.
example: ಸಂಗೀತ ಕೇಳುವ ವಿನಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ.
example_en: She has great interest in the act of listening to music.

definition: an iron rod.
example_en: The blacksmith heated the iron rod in the fire.

definition: a variety of banana tree.
example_en: The banana plants of that variety have grown well in the garden.

definition: (the skin) to become thick and hardened; to become callous.

example_en: Working in the sun made his palm become calloused.

definition: the ruddy goose, the male and female of which are supposed to be together always.
example_en: The ruddy geese sat together in pairs on the bank.

definition: the quality of being distinctive; distinctiveness.
example_en: The distinctiveness between the two pictures is clear.

definition: the quality or fact of having a protruding belly.
example_en: As he grew old, his protruding belly increased.

definition: not suitable for or consistent with the purpose or circumstances; unfit; improper.
example_en: His proposal was unsuitable at this time.

definition: supported, assisted, helped by a sponsor; sponsored.

definition: to hold or seize firmly.
example_en: The policeman held the thief firmly.

example_en: The priests performed a sacrificial ritual at home.

definition: a kind of deer whose bushy tail is used to make chowries.
example_en: They make chowries from the tail of the deer.

example_en: The musician examined the tuning of the veena.

definition: a path, way, road; a course.
example_en: This path leads to the town.

definition: a length of a rope.

definition: a bunch - a) a cluster or tuft of things growing together; b) a collection of things of the same kind fastened or grouped together.

definition: the undomesticated cat Felis chaus, a forest-inhabitant; wild-cat.

definition: a machine used to separate grains from the harvested crop.

definition: to go down or rest on the knees (as in praying); to kneel.

definition: wood used as fuel (or which is consumed by fire); firewood.

definition: a song sung or to be sung together; a chorus song.

definition: a variety of seedless grape.

definition: (fem.) a respectable teacher, preceptor.

definition: little scales or flakes of dead skin formed on the scalp; dandruff.

definition: the cardinal number eleven; 11.

definition: a fine rain; drizzle.

definition: cut;severed; broken.

definition: knowledge of letters.
example_en: Children are taught knowledge of letters at school.

definition: an announcement made in public, for making it widely known.
example_en: A public announcement of the new scheme was published in the newspapers.

definition: any of a class of insects that is not developed.
example_en: An undeveloped insect was crawling on the leaf.

definition: a receptacle vessel in a strainer; a vessel used for decanting or to hold decanted water from cooked rice.
example_en: She strains the rice water in the vessel.

definition: the quality of being impartial, unbiased; impartiality; unbiasedness.
example: ಎಲ್ಲ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸಮತ್ವ ಇರಬೇಕೆಂದು ಅವನು ಬಯಸಿದನು.
example_en: He wished that there should be equality among all castes.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument.
example_en: She happily played the dholak and sang.

definition: brightly; glitteringly.
example_en: The stars were glittering brightly in the sky.

definition: (dial.) a sect among the shepherd caste.
example_en: The Aḷūra clan are experts in sheep rearing.

definition: an arresting or being arrested; a taking or being taken into custody.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಪಿಡಿಕೆ ಕೋರ್ಟಿನ ಆದೇಶದಂತೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: That person's arrest happened as per the court's order.

definition: a difficulty in speaking that results in broken or inarticulate sounds and sometimes in complete stoppage of speech, caused by sudden excitement, confusion, embarrassment or other emotion or by chronic muscle spasm; stammering.
example_en: Because of fear, he developed a stammer.

definition: a preparation of powdered tobacco which is taken into the nostrils by inhalation; snuff.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಮೂಗಿಗೆ ತಪಕೀರ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ಕುಳಿತಳು.
example_en: The grandmother took some snuff into her nose and sat for a while.

definition: an ear-ring with a hanging.
example_en: The grandmother carefully took off her hanging earring and put it away.

definition: to refrain from talking; to keep oneself silent.
example_en: He kept himself silent in anger and said nothing.

definition: a slightly convex bronze disk that gives a loud, resonant tone when struck, used as a percussion instrument; one of a pair of large bronze cymbals; a gong.
example_en: During the festival they played the bronze cymbals loudly.
